_readme: Ground-truth class calls for plants.jpeg, made by eye at 4-10x zoom on the 768x1024 GT grid (see chunks/A0/FINDINGS.md). Region ids index the SAM partition in work/regions.npy; every id listed here was looked at in a zoom render before being written down. Passes apply in name order; later passes win.

pass01_petiole._note: Squash stem material: petioles, vines, peduncles, tendrils. Identified by the thick, pale, longitudinally-ribbed, hairy, round-sectioned look, verified against native-resolution crops (work/n_a.png, n_b.png, n_c.png).

pass02_fruit._note: Two kabocha fruit: the big dark one (171+172, split by a vine crossing it) and the small striped one (211).

pass03_weeds._note: Broadleaf weeds. Bottom-left patch (purslane-like, mallow-like and clover-like plants), a clover clump beside the fruit, two seedlings in the straw, and a dark ovate pinnate-veined weed growing up through the vines mid-frame (confirmed at native resolution, work/n_c.png).

pass04_grassoverleaf._note: Foreground grass blades lying over squash leaves (their parallel venation and keel are visible at native resolution), and leaf pixels the elongation heuristic mistook for blades: leaf-edge shadow (42), a young folded leaf (228, 227), sunlit specular streaks on a leaf (381, 610) and the shadow cast by a serrated leaf margin (295, 321, 312).

pass05_dryresidue._note: Dry dead plant material. `straw` in this schema means dry plant residue wherever it lies, including dried leaves and spent flower sheaths still attached to the squash.

pass06_other._note: A feather lying on the straw.

pass07_unlabelled._note: Regions I could not resolve. 43/56 are a deep-shadow tangle behind the crown where grass, straw and squash stem are interleaved below the resolution of this grid; 244 is a dark band under a leaf edge that is either the leaf's own shaded underside or shadowed material behind it. Marked unlabelled rather than guessed (roadmap A0 Notes).
